description: This file defines a Parcelable data class 'RatingInfo' used for representing rating preview information within an Android application. It includes properties like title, rating code, label, advisory, descriptors, countdown requirement, and countdown seconds, along with parcelable implementation methods.

classes.name: RatingInfo
classes.description: A Parcelable data class representing rating information including title, code, label, advisory, descriptors, and countdown details.

methods.name: describeContents
methods.description: Returns zero as required by Parcelable interface, indicating no special objects contained.

methods.name: writeToParcel
methods.description: Serializes the properties of RatingInfo into a Parcel for inter-process communication.
